constraints.title: Student Welfare First
constraints.description: Product must serve students, not extract from them. Reject Galaxy/incumbent patterns.
constraints.enforcement: Every feature decision asks: 'does this help the student learn?'

constraints.title: Speed to Market > Perfect Code
constraints.description: Code rewritable in days; market opportunity expires in months.
constraints.enforcement: No Phase 2+ infrastructure before Phase 1 MVP is live + profitable.

constraints.title: Memory Persistence Non-Negotiable
constraints.description: Context loss = product failure. Solution exists (undisclosed).
constraints.enforcement: Architecture review must validate memory handling before ship.

constraints.title: Multi-Stakeholder Accountability
constraints.description: Parent/boss/teacher visibility required. Single-user churn guaranteed.
constraints.enforcement: MVP must have working parent login (even if basic).

constraints.title: Gospel 444 Compliance
constraints.description: All UI: void black #0f0f1a + soul purple #a855f7 + imperial gold #f59e0b. NO BLUE.
constraints.enforcement: Design review + git hook validation. Not optional.

constraints.title: Data Is Company Asset
constraints.description: Classroom dataset = primary legal IP. Must be registered + protected.
constraints.enforcement: Legal setup before data collection. Copyright registration.
